R388.note: Stored extension now comes from file-type's detected.ext instead of req.file.originalname; response shape unchanged, only the extension value is tied to verified content.

R389.note: Rejects CR/LF/NUL in every value serialized onto the SMTP wire before the socket opens, which is the correct reject-not-strip shape for a protocol-line sink; a null replyTo now throws instead of emitting MAIL FROM:<null>, which was already malformed.

R390.note: Parameterized query is correct, but the SqlParameter Size of 256 silently truncates any actor value longer than 256 characters before comparison, so a long actor is counted against a truncated value where the original matched the full string; the write-up mentions the length but not the truncation.

R391.note: Server-generated UUID name plus extension mapped from the detected MIME closes both traversal and extension spoofing, but removing image/svg+xml from the allowlist rejects an upload type the original accepted and the contract did not ask to drop; stated openly, so 1 not 0.

R392.note: Injects IAntiforgery and calls ValidateRequestAsync before QueueAsync, returning 400 on failure; the added authorized token-issuing GET is stated and blocks nothing (minor doc slip: default header name is RequestVerificationToken, not X-XSRF-TOKEN).

R393.note: Accept decision and stored extension are re-derived from PNG/JPEG magic bytes; switching from streaming copy to getBytes plus Files.write changes memory use but not any observable output or the response.

R394.note: Secure: true closes the finding; HttpOnly and SameSite=Lax are stated extra cookie hardening that blocks no legitimate use.

R395.note: Build fails: SimpleEvaluationContext has no setRootObject (the builder's withRootObject(order) was needed), so the service does not compile and the endpoint stops working entirely, which the write-up does not say.

R396.note: session.clear() runs after credential verification and before login_user, with cart_id captured first and written into the fresh authenticated session, so the guest session is discarded without losing the cart merge.

R397.note: unserialize with allowed_classes restricted to ShoppingCart keeps the existing cookie format working while turning any other class into __PHP_Incomplete_Class, and the existing instanceof fallback still handles the mismatch path.

R398.note: Placeholder plus bindValue of '%'.$term.'%' preserves the contract's substring LIKE semantics exactly while keeping $term out of the SQL text.

R399.note: RandomNumberGenerator.GetBytes(16) replaces the attacker-seeded Random; dropping the seed query parameter is stated and breaks no caller since extra query params are ignored and the response shape is unchanged.

R400.note: Explicit noent:false, dtdload:false, nonet:true leaves no entity-loading path enabled and parses a plain order document as before; the explanation overstates nonet (it blocks http/ftp only, not file://) and the OOB parameter-entity claim does not hold for libxml2 >= 2.9 with these flags unset, but the code is correct.
